Key points
• To know the role of vitamin D in the prevention and treatment of non-communicable chronic diseases.
• To understand how vitamin D deﬁciency is related to obesity, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, type 2 diabetes,
cancer, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoporosis, chronic pulmonary obstructive disease, and inﬂammatory bowel disease.
